1396_s1.name: Season 1
1396_s1.overview: High school chemistry teacher Walter White's life is suddenly transformed by a dire medical diagnosis. Street-savvy former student Jesse Pinkman "teaches" Walter a new trade.

1.name: Pilot
1.overview: When an unassuming high school chemistry teacher discovers he has a rare form of lung cancer, he decides to team up with a former student and create a top of the line crystal meth in a used RV, to provide for his family once he is gone.

2.name: Cat's in the Bag...
2.overview: Walt and Jesse attempt to tie up loose ends. The desperate situation gets more complicated with the flip of a coin. Walt's wife, Skyler, becomes suspicious of Walt's strange behavior.

3.name: ...And the Bag's in the River
3.overview: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use, causing him to leave Walter alone with their captive, Krazy-8. Meanwhile, Hank has a scared straight moment with Walter Jr. after his aunt discovers he has been smoking pot. Also, Skylar is upset when Walter stays away from home.

4.name: Cancer Man
4.overview: Walter finally tells his family that he has been stricken with cancer. Meanwhile, the DEA believes Albuquerque has a new, big time player to worry about. Meanwhile, a worthy recipient is the target of a depressed Walter's anger, and Jesse makes a surprise visit to his parents home.

5.name: Gray Matter
5.overview: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's party. Jesse tries to free himself from the drugs, while Skyler organizes an intervention.

6.name: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
6.overview: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt. Meanwhile, the DEA rounds up suspected dealers.

7.name: A No Rough Stuff Type Deal
7.overview: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer after a PTA meeting. Elsewhere, Jesse decides to put his aunt's house on the market and Skyler is the recipient of a baby shower.

1396_s2.name: Season 2
1396_s2.overview: Walt must deal with the chain reaction of his choice, as he and Jesse face new and severe consequences. When danger and suspicion around Walt escalate, he is pushed to new levels of desperation. Just how much higher will the stakes rise? How far is Walt willing to go to ensure his family's security? Will his grand plan spiral out of control?

1.name: Seven Thirty-Seven
1.overview: Walt and Jesse are vividly reminded of Tuco’s volatile nature, and try to figure a way out of their business partnership. Hank attempts to mend fences between the estranged Marie and Skyler.

2.name: Grilled
2.overview: Walt and Jesse find themselves in close quarters with an unhinged Tuco. Marie and Hank comfort Skyler, who is distraught over Walt’s disappearance. Hank pays a visit to Mrs. Pinkman on some not-so-official business.

3.name: Bit by a Dead Bee
3.overview: Walt and Jesse become short on cash when they try to cover their tracks. Meanwhile, the DEA has a lead that could them straight to Walt and Jesse.

4.name: Down
4.overview: Walt attempts to reconnect with his family, while Jesse struggles to rebuild his life.

5.name: Breakage
5.overview: Hank suffers from the aftermath of his encounter with Tuco. Meanwhile, Jesse hires a crew to get their product out on the streets.

6.name: Peekaboo
6.overview: Walt's secret is in jeopardy when Skyler thanks Gretchen for paying for his treatment.

7.name: Negro y Azul
7.overview: Jesse and Walt discuss expanding into new territories; Hank struggles to fit in; Skyler pursues a new job opportunity; Jesse gets to know his landlord.

8.name: Better Call Saul
8.overview: Walt and Jesse seek advice from a shady attorney when Badger gets in trouble with the law; the DEA believes they have caught up with "Heisenberg" ; Hank returns.

9.name: 4 Days Out
9.overview: Walt and his family wait for news after he undergoes a PET-CT scan. Walt follows Saul's advice; Jesse's relationship with Jane is put on hold when he and Walt head to the desert for a marathon of cooking.

10.name: Over
10.overview: Walt and Hank get into a heated argument at a party. Skyler opens up to her boss. Jane hides her relationship with Jesse from her father.

11.name: Mandala
11.overview: As the end of her pregnancy finds Skyler conflicted about her feelings, a dealer's death forces Walt to look for somewhere to unload a load of meth.

12.name: Phoenix
12.overview: As Walt explores money laundering options, he and Jesse spar over the profits from their latest deal. Jesse and Jane clash with her father. Walt makes a fatal decision.

13.name: ABQ
13.overview: Skyler confronts Walt about his secrecy; Jesse falls apart; and Jane's grief-stricken father takes action that results in further tragedy.

1396_s3.name: Season 3
1396_s3.overview: Walt continues to battle dueling identities: a desperate husband and father trying to provide for his family, and a newly appointed key player in the Albuquerque drug trade. As the danger around him escalates, Walt is now entrenched in the complex worlds of an angst-ridden family on the verge of dissolution, and the ruthless and unrelenting drug cartel.

1.name: No Más
1.overview: Walt faces a new threat, on a new front and deals with an increasingly angry Skyler, who must consider what to do next with her life and the kids. Meanwhile, Jesse comes face-to-face with some startling self-revelations.

2.name: Caballo sin Nombre
2.overview: Despite ever-increasing tension between Walt and Skyler, he pulls out all the stops in an effort to reconcile with the family. Elsewhere, Saul is instrumental in getting Jesse involved in a most-unusual investment opportunity.

3.name: I.F.T.
3.overview: Walt ignores Skyler's demands, furthering the rift between them and pushing her to break bad. Still suffering from panic and anxiety attacks, Hank crosses a line at work.

4.name: Green Light
4.overview: Walt loses control as he reacts to Skyler's news, endangering his job and relationships with Saul and Jesse. Hank throws himself into his blue meth investigation. Jesse enacts a new plan.

5.name: Más
5.overview: Gus increases his efforts to lure Walt back into business, forcing a rift between Walt and Jesse. Skyler doubts her new relationship. Marie confides in Skyler about her concern for Hank's well-being.

6.name: Sunset
6.overview: Walt settles into his new surroundings; Walt, Jr. wants answers about his parents' relationship; Hank's investigation causes problems for Walt and Jesse.

7.name: One Minute
7.overview: Hank's increasing volatility forces a confrontation with Jesse and trouble at work. Skyler pressures Walt to make a deal. Gus' actions have severe consequences.

8.name: I See You
8.overview: The family waits for news about Hank. While Jesse covers at the lab, Walt attempts to placate Gus. After witnessing a disturbing outburst, Walt worries he and his family are in danger.

9.name: Kafkaesque
9.overview: As Hank's hospital bills stack up, Skyler hatches a plan. Walt and Gus come to a better understanding. Jesse, looking for more independence, pursues a new opportunity.

10.name: Fly
10.overview: Walt becomes obsessed with a contaminant in the lab and refuses to finish the cook until it is eliminated. A frustrated Jesse attempts to get Walt back on track.

11.name: Abiquiu
11.overview: Skyler gets involved with Walt's business. Hank struggles with his recovery. Jesse makes a startling discovery after meeting a girl at group therapy.

12.name: Half Measures
12.overview: Against Walt's advice, Jesse lashes out. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic action to intervene and tragic event leads to a shocking confrontation.

13.name: Full Measure
13.overview: With Jesse on the run and Mike in hot pursuit, Walt negotiates a bargain with Gus and concocts a disturbing plan to provide for his and Jesse's safety.

1396_s4.name: Season 4
1396_s4.overview: Walt and Jesse must cope with the fallout of their previous actions, both personally and professionally. Tension mounts as Walt faces a true standoff with his employer, Gus, with neither side willing or able to back down. Walt must also adjust to a new relationship with Skyler, whom while still reconciling her relationship with Walt, is committed to properly laundering Walt’s money and ensuring her sister Marie and an ailing Hank are financially stable.

1.name: Box Cutter
1.overview: Walt and Jesse face the deadly consequences of their actions. Skyler deals with a puzzling disappearance, as Marie struggles to help Hank with his recovery.

2.name: Thirty-Eight Snub
2.overview: Walt attempts to form a new alliance as he plans his next move. Skyler pushes Walt towards a business opportunity, in hopes of protecting the family.

3.name: Open House
3.overview: Events spiral out of control at Jesse's place. Skyler reluctantly asks for Saul's help. Marie returns to an old pastime and a friend asks Hank for help.

4.name: Bullet Points
4.overview: The Cartel takes steps to gain the upper hand. Walt and Skyler share an embarrassing secret with the rest of the family. Jesse's activities draw unwanted attention.

5.name: Shotgun
5.overview: When Jesse goes missing, Walt fears the worst. Skyler has an unlikely reunion. Hank shares some bad news with Detective Tim Roberts.

6.name: Cornered
6.overview: Skyler makes an unsettling discovery. Walter, Jr. pushes his dad into a questionable purchase. Jesse offers Mike some unexpected help.

7.name: Problem Dog
7.overview: A frustrated Walt gambles on a risky new plan. Skyler's business venture hits a snag. Hank recruits Walter, Jr. for an unusual outing.

8.name: Hermanos
8.overview: Skyler develops an unusual solution to her money troubles. Hank enlists Walt to investigate a theory. Walt's impatience with Jesse grows.

9.name: Bug
9.overview: Skyler's past mistakes come back to haunt her. Gus takes action to thwart his rivals. Jesse seeks Walt's help, with mixed results.

10.name: Salud
10.overview: Walt's family worries when he doesn't turn up for Walter, Jr.'s 16th birthday. Jesse is forced to put his lab skills to the test without Mr. White's help.

11.name: Crawl Space
11.overview: Walt takes drastic action to protect his secret and Gus. Skyler's efforts to solve Ted's financial problems hit a wall.

12.name: End Times
12.overview: Hank pushes Gomez to pursue one last lead, while Walt struggles to protect the family. Jesse gets alarming news and rushes to meet with Mr. White.

13.name: Face Off
13.overview: Walt and Jesse team up to take on Gus. With Saul's help, Walt finds an unexpected ally.

1396_s5.name: Season 5
1396_s5.overview: Walt is faced with the prospect of moving on in a world without his enemy. As the pressure of a criminal life starts to build, Skyler struggles to keep Walt’s terrible secrets. Facing resistance from sometime adversary and former Fring lieutenant Mike, Walt tries to keep his world from falling apart even as his DEA Agent brother in law, Hank, finds numerous leads that could blaze a path straight to Walt.

1.name: Live Free or Die
1.overview: As Walt deals with the aftermath of the Casa Tranquila explosion, Hank works to wrap up his investigation of Gus' empire.

2.name: Madrigal
2.overview: Walt and Jesse pursue an unlikely business partner. The DEA filters through various leads in hopes of finding something.

3.name: Hazard Pay
3.overview: Walt and Jesse formulate a new business plan. Walt shares a secret with Marie.

4.name: Fifty-One
4.overview: Walt celebrates another birthday. Skyler contemplates her options, and an associate puts a crimp in Walt and Jesse's business strategy.

5.name: Dead Freight
5.overview: Walt's team gets creative to obtain the methylamine they need to continue their operation.

6.name: Buyout
6.overview: Walt, Jesse, and Mike struggle over the future of their business, as occupational hazards weigh on Jesse.

7.name: Say My Name
7.overview: Walt takes control of business matters; Mike deals with the consequences of his actions.

8.name: Gliding Over All
8.overview: Walt takes care of loose ends; Walt makes a dangerous decision.

9.name: Blood Money
9.overview: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.

10.name: Buried
10.overview: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.

11.name: Confessions
11.overview: Jesse decides to make a change, while Walt and Skyler try to deal with an unexpected demand.

12.name: Rabid Dog
12.overview: An unusual strategy starts to bear fruit, while plans are set in motion that could change everything.

13.name: To'hajiilee
13.overview: Things heat up for Walt in unexpected ways.

14.name: Ozymandias
14.overview: Everyone copes with radically changed circumstances.

15.name: Granite State
15.overview: Events set in motion long ago move toward a conclusion.

16.name: Felina
16.overview: All bad things must come to an end.

106379_s1.name: Season 1
106379_s1.overview: 200 years after the apocalypse, the gentle denizens of luxury fallout shelters are forced to return to the incredibly complex, gleefully weird and highly violent universe waiting for them above.

1.name: The End
1.overview: Okey dokey...

2.name: The Target
2.overview: I know life can't have been easy up here...

3.name: The Head
3.overview: The Wasteland's got its own Golden Rule...

4.name: The Ghouls
4.overview: Death to Management.

5.name: The Past
5.overview: Everyone wants to save the world...

6.name: The Trap
6.overview: What happens when the ranchers have more power than the Sheriff?

7.name: The Radio
7.overview: Every generation has their own dumbass ideas...

8.name: The Beginning
8.overview: War...

1.name: The Innovator
1.overview: Every dollar spent is a vote cast.

2.name: The Golden Rule
2.overview: You can't put a price on family…

3.overview: Most kids are dead by this age.

4.name: The Demon in the Snow
4.overview: Rock to spear and so on...

5.overview: Big Whoop.

6.overview: I remember good people.

93405_s1.name: Season 1
93405_s1.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

1.name: Red Light, Green Light
1.overview: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

2.name: Hell
2.overview: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

3.name: The Man with the Umbrella
3.overview: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

4.name: Stick to the Team
4.overview: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

5.name: A Fair World
5.overview: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

6.name: Gganbu
6.overview: Players pair off for the fourth game. Gi-hun grapples with a moral dilemma, Sang-woo chooses self-preservation and Sae-byeok shares her untold story.

7.name: VIPS
7.overview: The Masked Leader welcomes VIP guests to the facility for a front-row viewing of the show. In the fifth game, some players crack under pressure.

8.name: Front Man
8.overview: Ahead of the last round, distrust and disgust run deep among the finalists. Jun-ho makes a getaway, determined to expose the game's dirty secrets.

9.name: One Lucky Day
9.overview: The final round presents another cruel test — but this time, how it ends depends on just one player. The game's creator steps out of the shadows.

93405_s2.name: Season 2
93405_s2.overview: Ready to run for your lives? Player 456 returns for more heart-pounding children's games, facing deadly new challenges — but armed with a hidden agenda.

1.name: Bread and Lottery
1.overview: A vengeful Gi-hun makes a U-turn at the airport. Later, in his hideout, he intensifies his search for the elusive recruiter who is seeking new players.

2.name: Halloween Party
2.overview: Gi-hun finally gets hold of an invitation, marked for Halloween day. In a tense moment facing Jun-ho, they reveal their truths to each other.

3.overview: New players gather for a chance to win 45.6 billion won. After an intense first round, the survivors' fates hang in the balance — down to one final vote.

4.name: Six Legs
4.overview: The players prepare for the next game: a six-legged pentathlon, where each team member must clear a mini-game to survive — or face collective elimination.

5.name: One More Game
5.overview: Kang No-eul earns enemies for her unruly actions. Nerves fray to the breaking point as the remaining players vote on whether to move to the next round.

6.name: O ﻿ X
6.overview: Jun-ho and his team prepare to infiltrate a suspicious island. As monetary stakes and tensions rise, players split into two opposing factions.

7.name: Friend or Foe
7.overview: The remaining players strategize on how to survive the night. Gi-hun proposes a risky plan — but he will need trustworthy allies to carry it out.

93405_s3.name: Season 3
93405_s3.overview: Gi-hun is devastated by the loss of his best friend and sinks into deep despair after discovering that the Game Master had hidden his true identity to secretly infiltrate the game.

1.name: Keys and Knives
1.overview: No-eul infiltrates a dangerous operation with a risky plan. A new game is announced: hide-and-seek, where one group holds a key and the other a knife.

2.name: The Starry Night
2.overview: The games resume, and Gi-hun fixates on confronting Kang Dae-ho. Meanwhile, Kim Jun-hee faces a sudden crisis that pushes her willpower to its limits.

3.name: It's Not Your Fault
3.overview: Jun-ho's team gets close to finding the island. Jang Geum-ja makes a desperate plea to Gi-hun to help Jun-hee. The VIPs discuss a cruel proposal.

4.overview: Even as Gi-hun supports Jun-hee amid rising tensions, she must make a pivotal decision. Before the final game, the Front Man gives Gi-hun an ultimatum.

5.overview: No-eul tries to gain the upper hand in negotiations, but her plans backfire. Gi-hun faces a moral crossroads, testing his limits — how far will he go?

6.name: Humans Are...
6.overview: As Jun-ho races to reach the island, tensions peak in the final round. The last players face an impossible situation in the closing minutes of the game.

1.name: Wednesday's Child Is Full of Woe
1.overview: When a deliciously wicked prank gets Wednesday expelled, her parents ship her off to Nevermore Academy, the boarding school where they fell in love.

2.name: Woe Is the Loneliest Number
2.overview: The sheriff questions Wednesday about the night's strange happenings. Later, Wednesday faces off against a fierce rival in the cutthroat Poe Cup race.

3.name: Friend or Woe
3.overview: Wednesday stumbles on a secret society. During Outreach Day, Nevermore's outcasts mingle with Jericho's normies in Pilgrim World. Fudge, anyone?

4.name: Woe What a Night
4.overview: Wednesday asks Xavier to the Rave'N dance, sparking Tyler's jealousy — but Thing's got something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Eugene stakes out the cave.

5.name: You Reap What You Woe
5.overview: During Parents Weekend, Wednesday digs into her family's past — and accidentally gets her dad arrested. Enid feels the pressure to "wolf out."

6.name: Quid Pro Woe
6.overview: Wednesday's friends throw her a surprise birthday party. They mean well... but she'd much rather mark the miserable occasion by solving the murders.

7.name: If You Don't Woe Me by Now
7.overview: Kooky Uncle Fester pays a visit and shares his theory about the monster. Wednesday begrudgingly agrees to a date with Tyler at Crackstone's crypt.

8.name: A Murder of Woes
8.overview: Wednesday lands in trouble with Principal Weems, but that's just the start of her problems. To fight an ancient evil, she'll need all her friends’ help.

1.name: Here We Woe Again
1.overview: After a productive summer break, Wednesday returns to Nevermore as a grudging campus celebrity — and the target of a dangerous stalker.

2.name: The Devil You Woe
2.overview: Chaos reigns on campus as Nevermore celebrates its annual Prank Day. Wednesday confronts an old enemy and gains an unwanted ally.

3.name: Call of the Woe
3.overview: Stripped of both her ability and Goody's book, Wednesday is forced to do some old-fashioned detective work on a school camping trip.

4.name: If These Woes Could Talk
4.overview: It's an Addams family investigation as Fester and Thing commit themselves to Wednesday's case. Trying to conceal one secret, Bianca stumbles on another.

5.name: Hyde and Woe Seek
5.overview: With Tyler on the loose, Wednesday readies for a risky Día de los Muertos showdown. Slurp's growing hunger poses problems for Pugsley.

6.name: Woe Thyself
6.overview: An encounter with a spirit from Nevermore's past gives Wednesday and Enid a new perspective on one another — and puts one of their classmates in danger.

7.name: Woe Me the Money
7.overview: As the school gala looms, Wednesday digs up dirt on Dort, Enid tries not to wolf out and Morticia engages in a battle of wills with Grandmama.

8.name: This Means Woe
8.overview: When buried family secrets are unearthed, Wednesday must race against time to prevent a dark prophecy from being realized.

1.name: Blood Calls Blood
1.overview: In 1850, Captain Charles Boone inherits his wealthy cousin's estate and relocates his family to small-town Maine where the Boones encounter prejudice, hostility, a mystery illness and murder as Charles begins a dangerous journey of self-discovery.

2.name: Memento Mori
2.overview: A child in town dies of a mystery illness and on her deathbed, credits Stephen Boone. Hysterical townsfolk demand that Charles dig up his cousin's grave. Charles refuses, but in private opens the grave and is shocked by what he finds.

3.name: Legacy of Madness
3.overview: Charles continues to hear rats behind the walls, despite assurances there are none. His search for answers leads to an insane asylum where his worst fears are realized.

4.name: The Promised
4.overview: Charles prepares to commit himself to the asylum for treatment but Tane discovers something disturbing in the barn that may help reveal Chapelwaite's secrets. A creepy cadre of emaciated Acolytes arrive with a message.

5.name: The Prophet
5.overview: The mysterious Jakub lures Charles to Jerusalem's Lot and he discovers that his madness is connected to an ancient book. The children are stunned and betrayed when Loa finds Rebecca's secret writings about the Boone family.

6.name: The Offer
6.overview: Charles is overwhelmed with grief and anger after his family is dealt a devastating blow. Stephen and Uncle Phillip come to Charles with a surprising proposition.

7.name: De Vermis Mysteriis
7.overview: Overwhelmed with madness, Charles is driven to the church cemetery where he unearths a hidden book. Once in his hands, he has an apocalyptic vision of the vampire future.

8.name: Hold the Night
8.overview: Charles and his family defend Chapelwaite with the help of Constable Dennison and Minister Burroughs. The night tests each character to their emotional limit.

9.name: The Gathering Dark
9.overview: Charles and company try to enlist men in town to fight in Jerusalem's Lot and retake the book.

10.name: The Keeper
10.overview: Jakub and his army come out of the dark and attack Charles and his fighters. Charles must make a decision to free his family of the ancient book's curse.

1.name: Black
1.overview: Intro to Kaleidoscope.

2.name: Yellow
2.overview: Leo assembles a team to steal billions in bonds from an impenetrable vault in New York City. Their first task: Secure seed money in the Diamond District.

3.name: Green
3.overview: A sobering diagnosis pushes Leo to break out of prison with help from a cellmate. After an emotional reunion on the outside, Leo begins plotting revenge.

4.name: Blue
4.overview: The team sets their intricate plan into motion amid news of a hurricane approaching the city. A paranoid Roger deals with a threat. The FBI gets a tip.

5.name: Orange
5.overview: Weeks before the heist, the squad hits a few obstacles as the FBI closes in on Ava and Bob copes with an injury. Agent Nazan seizes an opportunity.

6.name: Violet
6.overview: In the past, family man Leo tries to leave his life of crime behind, but a tempting job and a persuasive partner make old habits hard to break.

7.name: Red
7.overview: Tensions run high when the crew regroups after the heist and questions what went wrong — and who to trust. FBI agent Nazan makes a shocking discovery.

8.name: Pink
8.overview: Now in hiding after the heist, the crew faces new struggles. Roger conspires with an unlikely partner. The feds chase a lead in South Carolina.

9.name: White
9.overview: A master criminal and his crew hatch an elaborate scheme to break into a secure vault, but are forced to pivot when things don't go according to plan.

1.name: Cutline
1.overview: Kirby Mazrachi suspects her attacker from years earlier may be responsible for a recent murder, but she's challenged by her shifting reality.

2.name: Evergreen
2.overview: After new evidence supports Kirby's theory, reporter Dan Velazquez weighs using her as a source. Kirby takes a closer look at the victim.

3.name: Overnight
3.overview: Kirby and Dan look to the past, uncovering multiple cold cases with puzzling similarities. Harper takes a dangerous new interest in Dan.

4.name: Attribution
4.overview: As pressure mounts to go to print, Dan explores possible connections between the murder victims. Kirby tries to make sense of a piece of evidence.

5.name: Screamer
5.overview: Dan's article gains traction across the city. After a harrowing encounter, Kirby's grasp of reality comes into question.

6.name: Bright
6.overview: When Harper returns home from war, he finds a new beginning.

7.name: Offset
7.overview: A fresh lead sparks a breakthrough in the story. After Kirby drops a bombshell on Marcus, she goes to help a new friend.

8.overview: As Kirby's reality spirals, she sets her sights on finally tracking down Harper.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: When a neighbor's au pair vanishes after asking to talk with her, Cecilie feels responsible — compelling her to personally investigate.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: After finding potential evidence, Cecile grows suspicious of Rasmus. Assigned to Ruby's case, police officer Aicha gets in over her head.

3.name: Episode 3
3.overview: Cecilie secretly shares her discovery with Aicha. Viggo's friends pressure him to share inappropriate videos in their group chat.

4.name: Episode 4
4.overview: A break in the investigation leads Aicha to suspect the worst. Cecilie is suspicious of Mike after finding questionable information on his phone.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: Katarina asks Cecilie to help her with a painful task. Aicha is told to drop the case, fueling her determination to dig deeper.

6.name: Episode 6
6.overview: As those around her twist the narrative to their benefit, Cecilie is left wondering who she's really dealing with.

1.name: The Chosen One!
1.overview: Diagnosed with schizophrenia, Owen is the black sheep of the wealthy Milgrim clan. After losing his job, he enrolls in an experimental drug trial.

2.name: Windmills
2.overview: When her pilfered stash of pills runs out, troubled Annie tries to quit -- but ends up blackmailing her way into the Neberdine study.

3.name: Having a Day
3.overview: Muramoto notices irregularities in Annie and Owen's data. He questions Owen, who recalls the worst night of his life: his brother's engagement party.

4.name: Furs by Sebastian
4.overview: After taking the B pill, Annie and Owen find themselves on 1980s Long Island entangled in a strange caper involving a lemur.

5.name: Exactly Like You
5.overview: Annie and Owen are Arlie and Ollie, grifters attending a séance at the mysterious Neberdine mansion in the 1940s.

6.name: Larger Structural Issues
6.overview: Azumi tells James the whole truth about the study's snags and urges him to call his estranged mother, an esteemed therapist.

7.name: Ceci N'est Pas Une Drill
7.overview: Owen and Annie take the C pill. No longer connected, he belongs to a Mafia family, and she's a medieval guide hired by an ailing elf princess.

8.name: The Lake of the Clouds
8.overview: Annia and Ellia continue their quest, and Owen's mafioso father pressures him to protect the family. Greta counsels a bereaved Gertie.

9.name: Utangatta
9.overview: Owen and Annie meet again as a disgraced Icelandic spy and a CIA operative who helps him. Greta implores James to shut down the trial.

10.name: Option C
10.overview: After the subjects are discharged, James and Azumi face Neberdine's CEO. Owen and Annie part ways -- until a startling headline sparks a reunion.

1.name: Part 1
1.overview: Convicted murderess Grace Marks is interviewed by Dr. Simon Jordan. He becomes conflicted by Grace's enchanting, persuasive nature and her claims of having no memory of the events surrounding the murder.

2.name: Part 2
2.overview: In 1859, Simon dissects the events of the murders, while in 1842 Grace befriends Mary Whitney, whose death from a back-alley abortion traumatizes Grace to the point of hysteria.

3.name: Part 3
3.overview: In 1859 Simon attempts to extract Grace’s repressed memories of the murders. In 1842 Grace begins work as a servant at the Kinnear farmhouse.

4.name: Part 4
4.overview: In 1859 Simon becomes intimate with Mrs. Humphrey, while in 1843 Jamie confesses his love for Grace.

5.name: Part 5
5.overview: In 1859 Grace is convinced to try neuro-hypnosis to recover memories.

6.name: Part 6
6.overview: In 1859, Simon joins the Union Army, while in 1872 Grace gets unexpected news and makes a decision about her future.

1.name: This Is Where It Begins
1.overview: Adam Neumann is a young entrepreneur finding his path in the business world when he meets Rebekah, who inspires him to launch a company.

2.name: Masha Masha Masha
2.overview: Tying the knot after a whirlwind romance, Adam and Rebekah begin their life together as he expands WeWork and she pursues acting.

3.name: Summer Camp
3.overview: The growing WeWork team gathers on Rebekah's family property. Rebekah grapples with a public relations misstep and bad personal news.

4.overview: With Adam's fame growing and WeWork on the rise, Rebekah begins to feel sidelined at home and decides to pursue a new friendship.

2.overview: Developments in the case revive hope for grieving yet determined Marie. Meanwhile, a new father receives a disturbing email from a stranger.

3.name: Episode 3
3.overview: A sinister invitation leaves Naia fearing for her safety. Mark pursues a new theory in the stalking case that leads them to a troubled married couple.

4.name: Episode 4
4.overview: Reeling from a recent tragedy, Mark and the investigating team chase a dangerous suspect to a countryside inn — only to make a shocking discovery.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: The police celebrate an apparent victory, but Mark is unconvinced. As he desperately digs for evidence, an eerie case from the past catches his attention.

6.name: Episode 6
6.overview: As pieces of the chilling puzzle fall into place, the police race to uncover a hidden identity. But with time running out, will the killer strike again?

1.name: The Bird! The Bird!
1.overview: While crossing the Land of Ice, Toad gets kidnapped by a Giant Birdo who thinks the Mushroom is her missing baby.

2.name: King Mario of Cramalot
2.overview: With the help of the wizard Mervin, Mario pulls the Golden Plumber's Helper from the magic sink and saves the Land of Cramalot from evil King Koopa.

3.name: Butch Mario & the Luigi Kid
3.overview: Koopa the Kid has kidnapped the Princess and hidden her in the Old West, and when Mario and Luigi ride into town to save her they find Koopa has branded them wanted outlaws with rewards on their heads.

4.name: Mario's Magic Carpet
4.overview: The Marios wage a wild magic carpet battle to save the Princess from being forced into King Koopa's harem.

5.name: The Ringer
5.overview: When Ganon learns that there is to be an Amateur Magician's Contest in the Castle of Hyrule, he sees his chance.

6.name: Rolling Down the River
6.overview: Mario and Luigi disguise themselves as Riverboat Gamblers to rescue the Princess who is held captive on Captain Koopa's sidewheeler, "The Sinister Star".

7.name: The Great Gladiator Gig
7.overview: Our heroes think they are going to a benefit Spaghetti Dinner at the Linguini Empire Colosseum, but it's all a plot by the evil Emperor Augustus Septemberus Octoberus Koopa to feed the Marios to the lions.

8.name: Mario and the Beanstalk
8.overview: When the Marios buy some magic garbanzo beans they are lead up the beanstalk to face a Giant Koopa.

9.name: Love 'Em and Leave 'Em
9.overview: The dreaded Queen Rotunda of Rotundaland falls in love with Mario when she mistakenly drinks a love potion and tries to force him into marriage.

10.name: Cold Spells
10.overview: When it's spring cleaning time in the castle, Link pretends to have a cold in order to get out of doing work.

11.name: The Great BMX Race
11.overview: To save Toad's life, Mario and Luigi are tricked into a disaster-strewn Boy's Motor Cross bicycle race with three of Koopa's sneakiest minions.

12.name: Stars in Their Eyes
12.overview: Our heroes get chased to the Planet Quirk where Koopa has enslaved the natives and then puts the Marios into slavery, too.

13.name: Jungle Fever
13.overview: Mario, Luigi, The Princess, and Toad hack their way through the Ama-Zone Jungle searching for Sheldon the Witch Doctor, but Koopa gets to him first.

14.name: Brooklyn Bound
14.overview: The Marios finally find a way back to Brooklyn -- and are faced with a big decision when Koopa captures the Princess just at the moment they can return home.

15.name: The White Knight
15.overview: When the handsome Prince Facade shows up in Hyrule, Zelda cannot keep her eyes off of him, and Link is green with jealousy.

16.name: Toad Warriors
16.overview: King Koopa steals every drop of spaghetti sauce in Car Land, but our heroes come to the rescue of the Mushroom Colonists when Toad turns super and saves the day.

17.name: The Fire of Hercufleas
17.overview: The Marios seek the help of the legendary hero Hercufleas, but find it's the hero himself who needs help to recover the "Great Balls of Fire" stolen by King Koopa.

18.name: Count Koopula
18.overview: Our heroes are lured into a spooky castle in the Land of Turtlevania where Count Koopula plans to turn the Princess into a spaghetti-sauce-sucking vampire.

19.name: Pirates of Koopa
19.overview: Long John Koopa kidnaps the Princess and is auctioning her off to his fellow pirates when our heroes arrive in pirate disguises.

20.name: Kiss 'N Tell
20.overview: When Link rescues a fair maiden from a ferocious dragon, he gets a kiss as his reward. But the maiden is one of Ganon's evil creatures in disguise, and Link is turned into a frog!

21.name: Two Plumbers and a Baby
21.overview: When Koopa misuses the Fountain of Youth to turn the Princess into a baby, the Marios get stuck with a big babysitting problem.

22.name: The Adventures of Sherlock Mario
22.overview: When Professor Koopa-arity kidnaps the brilliant criminologist Herlock Sholmes, the Marios turn detective.

23.name: Do You Princess Toadstool Take This Koopa...?
23.overview: Koopa threatens to turn the Marios into rocks unless Princess Toadstool agrees to marry him.

24.name: The Pied Koopa
24.overview: King Koopa acquires a magic flute that makes him irresistible to the children of Pastaland and he leads them all to his castle until the Marios come to their rescue.

25.name: Sing for the Unicorn
25.overview: You'd think a King would be safe standing on top of his own castle. But not when Ganon has managed to capture a flying Unicorn!

26.name: Koopenstein
26.overview: Dr. Koopenstein starts the trouble by trying to steal the Marios' brains for his new invention, and then he really turns into a monster.

27.name: On Her Majesty's Sewer Service
27.overview: When Princess Toadstool's chief spy (James Blond) is zapped by Koopa, Mario and Luigi turn secret agent.

28.name: Mario and Joliet
28.overview: Our heroes arrive for the wedding of Romero and Joliet, only to find Koopa has reignited the feud between the two lovers' families.

29.name: Too Hot to Handle
29.overview: Koopa has imprisoned the Fire God of Lavalava Land and forces the natives to sacrifice the Princess Toadstool to the local volcano.

30.name: That Sinking Feeling
30.overview: Ganon has a new toy: an Overworld Magnet, capable of pulling any object in the Overworld down into the Underworld.

31.name: Hooded Robin and His Mario Men
31.overview: The Marios arrive in Sharewood Forest and help the Hooded Robin recover the gold coins that the rich Sheriff of Koopingham has stolen from the poor.

32.name: 20,000 Koopas Under the Sea
32.overview: Our heroes travel to Oceanworld where they discover Captain Koopa-Nemo is using a super submarine to terrorize the Mushroom People.

33.name: Mighty McMario and the Pot of Gold
33.overview: When a Leprechaun our heroes meet in Shamrock Land asks them to help recover his Pot O'Gold Coins stolen by Koopa, the Marios can only say "yes".

34.name: Mario Meets Koop-zilla
34.overview: Koopa has eaten Dr. T. Garden's secret weapon -- Super Sushi -- and has been transformed into the huge monster "Koopzilla" who is terrorizing the city of Sayonara.

35.name: Doppelganger
35.overview: When Zelda finds a huge and beautiful mirror in her room, she naturally assumes that it is a present from Link. But in fact it is a present from Ganon -- as Zelda soon discovers!

36.name: Koopa Klaus
36.overview: When the evil Koopa Claus (Bah Humkoop!) tries to stop Christmas, the Marios come to Santa's rescue and Toad learns the true spirit of giving.

37.name: Mario and the Red Baron Koopa
37.overview: When Koopa teams up with the dreaded sky turtle Lakatu, our heroes head for an aerial dogfight in their flying carpet biplane.

38.name: The Unzappables
38.overview: Mario and his friends travel to Mobsterland where they discover the city is being terrorized by the notorious gangster Al Koopone.

39.name: Bad Rap
39.overview: Koopa kidnaps the King of Rapland where everyone speaks in rap rhyme and it's up to the rapping Marios to save the day.

40.name: Underworld Connections
40.overview: Ganon's evil creatures attack the castle and break the Triforce into three pieces.

41.name: The Mark of Zero
41.overview: Mario and Luigi come to El Desertland's rescue against the evil Capitan El Koopa by donning black masks and capes to become the legendary heros "Zero" and "Zero Plus One".

42.name: The Ten Koopmandments
42.overview: Our heroes travel to Desertland where they discover Koop-Tut has enslaved the Desertlanders and is enforcing an evil set of rules known as the Ten Koopmandments.

43.name: The Koopas Are Coming! The Koopas Are Coming!
43.overview: Our heroes come to the rescue of General George Washingtoad by helping him cross the Delawide River to defeat the Redcoat Koopa's army.

44.name: The Trojan Koopa
44.overview: When King Koopa holds the Princess captive in his impregnable island fortress, the Marios get inside by hiding in a wooden "Trojan Koopa."

45.name: Stinging a Stinger
45.overview: Link rescues an old man named Sleazenoze from attackers in the woods, and as a reward, the old man gives Link a brand-new fancy sword in exchange for his old one.

46.name: Quest For Pizza
46.overview: When Caveman Alley Koopa poisons Mario, his three friends have to find a way to make pre-historic pizza to save his life.

47.name: The Great Gold Coin Rush
47.overview: The Marios discover the Mother Lode of Gold Coins, but -- Klaimjump Koopa rides in and takes over.

48.name: Elvin Lives
48.overview: The Marios, the Princess, and Toad arrive in Sock Hop Land to save the music king Elvin Parsley from Greaser Koopa.

49.name: Plummers Academy
49.overview: In a flashback to their days of Basic Draining at the Brooklyn Academy of Plumbing, Mario and Luigi tell of their troubles with Drain Sergeant Kooperman and why the President of the United States called them to the White House.

50.name: Hitch in the Works
50.overview: When Ganon captures Zelda, he has a most evil plot in mind: using the Crystal of Control he has just discovered, he will force Zelda to marry him -- and then Hyrule will be under his control!

51.name: Karate Koopa
51.overview: Our heroes return to the oriental city of Sayonara where they combat Karate Koopa and his Ninja Ninjiis with the martial art of Plumb-Fu.

52.name: Mario of the Apes
52.overview: Mario loses his memory in the middle of the jungle and is adopted by two apes who rename him Marzan.

53.name: Princess, I Shrunk the Mario Brothers
53.overview: When Toad accidentally spills a shrinking potion on the Marios they must overcome the perils of giant Troopas, drain pipes filled with monster-sized bugs, and Koopa's big feet.

54.name: Little Red Riding Princess
54.overview: Our heroes have come to Winterland so the Princess can visit her grandmother, but Koopa sees her crossing the forest all alone and plays big bad wolf.

55.name: Fairies in the Spring
55.overview: When King Harkinnian decides to build a Royal Water Park for the enjoyment of all his subjects during the hot weather, it seems like a simple enough project. But a hitch rapidly develops when the water park construction suffers a a series of strange attacks by water creatures!

56.name: The Provolone Ranger
56.overview: Mario teams up with a friendly mushroom Indian named Pronto to rescue his friends from Billy The Koopa in the Wild West.

57.name: Escape From Koopatraz
57.overview: The Marios, the Princess, and Toad are captured by Koopa and sent to his island dungeon Koopatraz where they engineer a daring escape.

58.name: Mario of the Deep
58.overview: Koopa has moved his underhandedness under the sea, has captured King Neptune, and is forcing the Mermushrooms to loot the sunken ships of gold coins.

59.name: Flatbush Koopa
59.overview: The Marios return to Brooklyn to find that Koopa has taken over and renamed the City Kooplyn.

60.name: The Missing Link
60.overview: Ganon, attempting to capture Link with a magical zapblast, succeeds in capturing his body, but not his spirit.

61.name: Raiders of the Lost Mushroom
61.overview: Indiana Mario and his friends travel to Jungleland in search of a legendary golden statuette -- "The Lost Mushroom."

62.name: Crocodile Mario
62.overview: Our heroes arrive in Down Under Land and have to save the Outback Mushroom People from Kangaroo Koopa and an army of crocodiles.

63.name: Star Koopa
63.overview: Our heroes are chased through space by Darth Koopa and thrown into the Intergalactic Insinkerator.

64.name: Robo Koopa
64.overview: Koopa forces the brilliant scientist Dr. Nerdnick to turn him into a half-robot, half-Koopa monster.

65.name: The Moblins Are Revolting
65.overview: When Ganon's evil creatures suffer yet another humiliating defeat at the hands of Link, they decide that Ganon's stupid plans are to blame.

1399_s1.name: Season 1
1399_s1.overview: Trouble is brewing in the Seven Kingdoms of Westeros. For the driven inhabitants of this visionary world, control of Westeros' Iron Throne holds the lure of great power. But in a land where the seasons can last a lifetime, winter is coming...and beyond the Great Wall that protects them, an ancient evil has returned. In Season One, the story centers on three primary areas: the Stark and the Lannister families, whose designs on controlling the throne threaten a tenuous peace; the dragon princess Daenerys, heir to the former dynasty, who waits just over the Narrow Sea with her malevolent brother Viserys; and the Great Wall--a massive barrier of ice where a forgotten danger is stirring.

1.name: Winter Is Coming
1.overview: Jon Arryn, the Hand of the King, is dead. King Robert Baratheon plans to ask his oldest friend, Eddard Stark, to take Jon's place. Across the sea, Viserys Targaryen plans to wed his sister to a nomadic warlord in exchange for an army.

2.name: The Kingsroad
2.overview: While Bran recovers from his fall, Ned takes only his daughters to Kings Landing. Jon Snow goes with his uncle Benjen to The Wall. Tyrion joins them.

3.name: Lord Snow
3.overview: Lord Stark and his daughters arrive at King's Landing to discover the intrigues of the king's realm.

4.name: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things
4.overview: Eddard investigates Jon Arryn's murder. Jon befriends Samwell Tarly, a coward who has come to join the Night's Watch.

5.name: The Wolf and the Lion
5.overview: Catelyn has captured Tyrion and plans to bring him to her sister, Lysa Arryn, at The Vale, to be tried for his, supposed, crimes against Bran. Robert plans to have Daenerys killed, but Eddard refuses to be a part of it and quits.

6.name: A Golden Crown
6.overview: While recovering from his battle with Jamie, Eddard is forced to run the kingdom while Robert goes hunting. Tyrion demands a trial by combat for his freedom. Viserys is losing his patience with Drogo.

7.name: You Win or You Die
7.overview: Robert has been injured while hunting and is dying. Jon and the others finally take their vows to the Night's Watch. A man, sent by Robert, is captured for trying to poison Daenerys. Furious, Drogo vows to attack the Seven Kingdoms.

8.name: The Pointy End
8.overview: Eddard and his men are betrayed and captured by the Lannisters. When word reaches Robb, he plans to go to war to rescue them. The White Walkers attack The Wall. Tyrion returns to his father with some new friends.

9.name: Baelor
9.overview: Robb goes to war against the Lannisters. Jon finds himself struggling on deciding if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Drogo has fallen ill from a fresh battle wound. Daenerys is desperate to save him.

10.name: Fire and Blood
10.overview: With Ned dead, Robb vows to get revenge on the Lannisters. Jon must officially decide if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Daenerys says her final goodbye to Drogo.

1.name: Muddy Puddles
1.overview: It's raining and Peppa is sad because she can't play outside. When the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games - jumping in muddy puddles! When Mummy and Daddy Pig join in, things get very muddy indeed.

2.name: Mr. Dinosaur is Lost
2.overview: Mr Dinosaur is George's favourite toy. When Mr Dinosaur goes missing, George is distraught. Daddy Pig helps Peppa to become a detective and together they track down Mr Dinosaur, making George a very happy little piggy again.

3.name: Best Friend
3.overview: Peppa's best friend, Suzy Sheep, comes to play. George wants to play too, but Peppa refuses to let him do so, making him sad.

4.name: Polly Parrot
4.overview: Peppa and George visit Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's house, and meet their new parrot, Polly.

5.name: Hide and Seek
5.overview: George and Peppa are playing hide and seek, and Peppa thinks that George is bad at the game.

6.name: The Playgroup
6.overview: George is joining Peppa at her playgroup but she doesn't really want him there - until her friends decide that George is brilliant.

7.name: Mummy Pig at Work
7.overview: Mummy Pig is trying to work on her computer, however when Peppa and George are trying to play their computer game "Happy Mrs. Chicken," The computer crashes.

8.name: Piggy in the Middle
8.overview: Peppa teases George because he cannot catch the ball. Mummy Pig suggests a game of Piggy in the Middle to help George learn.

9.name: Daddy Loses His Glasses
9.overview: Daddy Pig has lost his glasses and cannot see very well without them.

10.name: Gardening
10.overview: Peppa and the others plant a strawberry tree, but it takes a long time for the seed to grow.

12.name: Bicycles
12.overview: Peppa Pig and George decide it is a great day to go and ride bicycles while Daddy Pig is admiring a prize-winning pumpkin he has. However Peppa accidentally smashes into the pumpkin!

13.name: Secrets
13.overview: Mummy Pig gives Peppa a box, which has to be kept a secret.

14.name: Flying a Kite
14.overview: Peppa goes outside and plays with her kite.

15.name: Picnic
15.overview: Peppa and her family go on a picnic.

16.name: Musical Instruments
16.overview: Mummy and Daddy Pig find an old box in the attic. It is full of musical instruments.

17.name: Frogs and Worms and Butterflies
17.overview: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden. Peppa pretends to be a butterfly.

18.name: Dressing Up
18.overview:
Peppa, George, and her friends play dress up.

Peppa and George love dressing up, so one day they creep into Mummy and Daddy's room and dress up in their clothes.

19.name: New Shoes
19.overview: Peppa loses her shoes, but she gets new red ones, making her happy again.

20.name: The School Fete
20.overview: Peppa and her family go to the school fete. Peppa and George have their faces painted as tigers, and Daddy Pig makes a dinosaur out of a balloon.

21.name: Mummy Pig's Birthday
21.overview: Mummy Pig celebrates her birthday with her family. Peppa, George and Daddy Pig prepare a wonderful birthday surprise for Mummy Pig.

22.name: The Tooth Fairy
22.overview: Peppa has lost a tooth, so she puts it under her pillow for the Tooth Fairy.

23.name: The New Car
23.overview: Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down.

24.name: Treasure Hunt
24.overview: Granny and Grandpa Pig organise a treasure hunt in the garden for Peppa and George.

25.name: Not Very Well
25.overview: Peppa is ill and has red spots all over her face. Dr Brown Bear tells her she will be fine but she must stay in bed.

26.name: Snow
26.overview: Peppa and George go outside to play in the snow.

27.name: Windy Castle
27.overview: Peppa and her family go to Windy Castle, and when they get there, they see Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's house.

28.name: My Cousin Chloé
28.overview: Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.

29.name: Pancakes
29.overview: Mummy Pig makes pancakes, and Peppa and George help. Daddy Pig flips one so high that it sticks to the ceiling.

30.name: Babysitting
30.overview: Mummy and Daddy Pig go out for the evening, leaving Granny and Grandpa Pig to babysit an excitable Peppa and George.

31.name: Ballet Lesson
31.overview: Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson and later teaches Mummy and Daddy Pig some dances.

32.name: Thunderstorm
32.overview: Peppa and George get caught in a thunderstorm.

33.name: Cleaning the Car
33.overview: Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.

34.name: Lunch
34.overview: When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

35.name: Camping
35.overview: Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone to fit in.

36.name: The Sleepy Princess
36.overview: It's bedtime but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur!

37.name: The Tree House
37.overview: Grandpa Pig has a surprise for Peppa and George - a beautiful tree house in his garden.

38.name: Fancy Dress Party
38.overview: Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.

39.name: The Museum
39.overview: Peppa and her family visit the museum. Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.

40.name: Very Hot Day
40.overview: It is a very hot day. Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but all the puddles have dried up.

41.name: Chloé's Puppet Show
41.overview: Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloé. Chloé has a new puppet theatre.

42.name: Daddy Gets Fit
42.overview: Peppa tells Daddy Pig that he needs to exercise instead of watching television, so he starts getting fit.

43.name: Tidying Up
43.overview: Peppa and George are told to tidy their room, because it is so messy.

44.name: The Playground
44.overview: Peppa and George go to the playground, and Peppa's friends are also there.

45.name: Daddy Puts Up a Picture
45.overview: Daddy Pig decides to put up a picture of Peppa and George on the wall, but accidentally cracks the wall while doing it.

46.name: At the Beach
46.overview: Peppa and her family go to the beach, and they do lots of things there.

47.name: Mister Skinnylegs
47.overview: George finds a spider in the bathroom sink, and when Peppa sees it, she screams and runs downstairs to tell Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig.

48.name: Grandpa Pig's Boat
48.overview: Peppa and George go for a ride in Grandpa Pig's boat, but Grandpa Pig and Grandpa Dog get into a fight.

49.name: Shopping
49.overview: Peppa and her family go to the shops for some tomatoes, spaghetti, onions and fruit, but Daddy Pig gets some chocolate cake too.

50.name: My Birthday Party
50.overview: It's Peppa Pig's birthday today. Peppa wakes up very early so she doesn't waste any of her special day.

51.name: Daddy's Movie Camera
51.overview: Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera, but has some difficulties with it.

52.name: School Play
52.overview: Peppa and her friends take part in a school play.

70788_s1.name: Season 1
70788_s1.overview: The series starts during the 20th year of the sultan's reign. They are planning a big project, the Hejaz Railway. However, the Sultan's brother-in-law, Mahmut Paşa, the Brits, and Theodore Herzl are trying to sabotage this project. In the harem, on the other hand, a strong rivalry between Bidar Sultan and Seniha Sultan extends to their family. Also, the sultan's brother Murad's daughters come to the palace. His eldest daughter, Hatice Sultan, falls in love with Kemalettin Paşa and plans to marry him while on the other hand Naime Sultan, the Sultan's daughter, also is in love with Kemalettin and tries to win his heart, eventually getting ill. Hatice Sultan with her love for Naime pretends that Kemalettin loves Naime by giving a Naime a letter which Kemalettin had written to Hatice. Mahmut Paşa, Seniha Sultan's husband, piles slander upon slander on Mehmet Paşa, Bidar Sultan's brother, eventually getting him exiled.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: As Sultan Abdülhamid tries to finalise the plans for the Hejaz railway, forces both at home and abroad actively work towards the downfall of the Ottoman Caliphate.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: Enemies close in on Abdülhamid and make their move during a parade. The sultan becomes aware that there is a traitor in their midst and makes his own move.

3.name: Episode 3
3.overview: As Mehmet Paşa seeks refuge at the German embassy, Abdülhamid tries his best to bring him to justice. In Vienna, the first unofficial Zionist congress takes place and Theodore Herzl rallies support for his cause.

4.name: Episode 4
4.overview: The enemy strikes in Yildiz Palace and puts everyone on alert. While the crisis is ongoing, Theodore Herzl makes his move too.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: As Abdülhamid interrogates the perceived traitor, the youth become restless in the streets of the capital over the shooting of a journalist. Bidar Sultan retakes her place at the head of the harem after ousting Seniha Sultan. Theodore Herzl sets his plan in motion to disrupt the market.

6.name: Episode 6
6.overview: The plan to disrupt the market was thwarted at the last minute as Lady Fatma Pesend makes it safely to the capital. Bidar Sultan reveals Makbule to be still alive and in Palestine a plan to sacrifice Jews for the creation of a state of Israel is put in motion.

7.name: Episode 7
7.overview: Kemalettin Paşa and Celalettin save the Jews in Palestine from Theodore Herzl's plans as they report back to the capital. As Sara is in Abdülhamid's custody, enemies scramble to take her back from the palace. Ömer is racing against the clock as his own family is now in jeopardy.

8.name: Episode 8
8.overview: Valide Sultan makes her appearance as Bidar Sultan and Seniha Sultan try to gain control over Makbule. Sara realises her release is not going to save her as she suffers from the poison. Abdülkadir Şehzade meddles in the games that are being played at the palace and gets himself in a awkward position. The British receive another blow as their captured spy is released by Sultan Abdülhamid.

9.name: Episode 9
9.overview: Abdülkadir Şehzade's plan to give Ahsen the flower is not as it seems and Samir realises he's been manipulated all along by Sara. Abdülhamid learns that Armenians are planning to attack the capital as he tries to track the weapons. Kemalettin Paşa is caught in a  love triangle with Naime and Hatice.

10.name: Episode 10
10.overview: As predicted by Abdülhamid, Sara is once again in his custody and her life is in grave danger if she doesn't speak. Zaharoff enters the game as he plans to plant a cross on the Hagia Sophia and wage war on Islam. Kemalettin's love for Hatice puts his father, Gazi Osman Paşa, in a position of suspicion.

11.name: Episode 11
11.overview: Gazi Osman Paşa's betrayal continues as he becomes part of the plan to attack the capital. The pieces for the attack are in place, now it is only a matter of time...

12.name: Episode 12
12.overview: Ömer is tasked by the Sultan to retrieve the book containing the names of Indian muslims who contributed to the railway. In the palace, Seniha Sultan and Bidar Sultan team up to save the hostages in the Ottoman Bank.

13.name: Episode 13
13.overview: Sultan Abdülhamid reveals his trump card as he strikes at the British. In an attempt to get rid of Mahmut Paşa, Basil Zaharoff spreads news that gets Mahmut Paşa in deep trouble. Abdülkadir Şehzade and Burhanettin Şehzade make a move to calm the Armenians.

14.name: Episode 14
14.overview: The aftermath of the raid on the Ottoman Bank seems a success for Theodore Herzl, as he tries to escape the capital. In the palace, Lady Fatma Pesend unwillingly becomes part of the game as Seniha Sultan puts the plan in motion to ascend her brother Murad Sultan.

15.name: Episode 15
15.overview: Sultan Abdülhamid clears the air with his brother Sultan Murad over him ascending the throne. With Sabahattin caught in the plan of Mahmut Paşa, who will they sacrifice to free Sabahattin? The railway issue is once again being discussed but the threat of war is looming...

16.name: Episode 16
16.overview: With Theodore Herzl's plan to buy Palestine land thwarted, he turns to his friend Emmanuel Carasso for help. With Sara once again in the palace, Parvus is eager to get her out. The Surre Regiment is departing to Mecca for the yearly pilgrimage, but Sultan Abdülhamid has other plans for it's leader...

17.name: Episode 17
17.overview: With the kidnapping of Mahmut Paşa as head of the Surre Regiment, Sultan Abdülhamid seems to have found his traitor, now all he needs is proof... Ömer is trying to steer his friend Yusuf away from the wrong path, but Yusuf is only getting himself in deeper and deeper.  An attack on an Ottoman outpost catalyses the war with Greece.

67144_s1.name: Season 1
67144_s1.overview: In 1268, Mongol invasions in Anatolia lead to Yunus's appointment as a judge in Nallıhan. Later, he joins Tapduk Emre's lodge to train as a dervish.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: As Anatolia wrestles with the aftermath of Mongolian raids, Yunus meets an old man on the road who has a profound effect on his life.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: Yunus presides over the trial of a murder he encounters on the road, but the sheikh, Tabduk Emre, challenges his verdict.

3.name: Episode 3
3.overview: Yunus's sentence drives a wedge between him and the Brotherhood, and he appears before the sheikh regarding the appeal.

4.name: Episode 4
4.overview: The death sentence may change the course of Yunus's life, and he is torn between Tabduk Emre and the Brotherhood.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: Realizing the gravity of his mistake, Yunus considers resigning to become a dervish under the sheikh.

6.name: Episode 6
6.overview: Yunus struggles within himself as he waits for the sheikh and the Brotherhood's response to his actions.

7.name: Episode 7
7.overview: Tabduk Emre gives Yunus his first mission as a dervish, but Yunus is unaware of the difficulty of the task.

8.name: Episode 8
8.overview: Yunus adjusts to his new life at the lodge. Tabduk sends Yunus out on a new mission, and Yunus attracts Bacım Sultan's attention.

9.name: Episode 9
9.overview: Tabduk awaits Yunus's return, but his safety is not guaranteed. Endişe Nallıhan remembers Huseyin and Karbala.

10.name: Episode 10
10.overview: Yunus saves Demirci Bayram, but the mission pushes him to ponder resistance. The Nallıhan Brotherhood's tax burden grows by the day.

11.name: Episode 11
11.overview: Troubled by the sheikh's requests, Yunus wonders whether he will find what he seeks. Tabduk and the Brotherhood discuss the Seljuks's status.

12.name: Episode 12
12.overview: Upon learning that the lodge is under threat, Yunus returns to Nallıhan, where Kadı Ilyas and a friend try to talk him into staying.

13.name: Episode 13
13.overview: Yunus is helpless to stop the raid, and the time has come for his return to Konya. Kadı Ilyas's motives are called into question.

15.name: Episode 15
15.overview: Tabduk is cleared of the accusations made against him. Yunus is stranded on the road after falling from a horse, and comes face to face with a snake.

16.name: Episode 16
16.overview: A man Yunus once sentenced to death finds him and brings him back to the lodge, where Yunus sees his older self in a dream.

17.name: Episode 17
17.overview: Still unconscious, Yunus reacts physically to his dreams, creating disquiet in the lodge and worrying the sheikh.

18.name: Episode 18
18.overview: Yunus regains consciousness, and his body continues to heal with the help of Tabduk and family members. An unusual sadness overtakes Bacım Sultan.

19.name: Episode 19
19.overview: Yunus recovers, but cannot recall his past. As Yunus searches for his identity, Molla Kasım and Bacım Sultan adapt to the new realities.

20.name: Episode 20
20.overview: Yunus comes to his senses and continues to repeat the mantra "I do not know." Tabduk's training method for Yunus changes.

21.name: Episode 21
21.overview: For his new mission, Yunus disguises himself as a water carrier and observes people's conditions through the eyes of a dervish.

22.name: Episode 22
22.overview: Yunus learns greatly from every conversation with Tabduk Emre and becomes more determined to take action based on what he hears.

1.name: Episode 27
1.overview: Aykiz takes matters into her own hands and pays Eftelya a visit. Ustadi Azam goes after a mole on his own turf.

2.name: Episode 28
2.overview: Gundogdu and Selcan come to blows over her ambitions. Ertugrul brings pressure to bear on Eftelya, but the tribe needs her alive.

3.name: Episode 29
3.overview: To infiltrate the Knights Templar's base, Ertugrul deliberately leaks information. Numan's decision deals a major blow to Halime.

4.name: Episode 30
4.overview: Ertugrul captures an important prisoner on the way. Ustadu Azam grooms Yigit for the final stage of his plan.

5.name: Episode 31
5.overview: A message arrives at the Kayi camp, and Selcan decides it is time to settle accounts with Suleyman. Marcus falls for the Kayi tribe's ruse.

6.name: Episode 32
6.overview: Titus wreaks havoc on the camp. A surprise visitor knocks on Afsin's door, and Numan leaves Ertugrul no choice but to walk away from Halime.

7.name: Episode 33
7.overview: As Titu's plan spirals out of control and he and Kurdoglu look for a way out, Sahabettin watches them closely.

8.name: Episode 34
8.overview: The Knights Templar's position in Aleppo depends on Eftelya, who tries to turn Ertugrul against Halime.

9.name: Episode 35
9.overview: Eftelya decides her own fate. A showdown between Ertugrul and Titus gets interrupted, and Ertugrul questions Kara Toygar's true motives.

10.name: Episode 36
10.overview: Nasir oversteps his bounds with El Aziz, and Halime seizes her chance to appeal on behalf of the Kayi tribe.

11.name: Episode 37
11.overview: In pitting herself against Selcan, Aykiz plays with fire. Ertugrul rushes to head off the diplomatic mess Nasir created.

12.name: Episode 38
12.overview: Selcan falls out of Hayme's favor. Ertugrul walks into an important meeting and exposes a conspiracy against his tribe.

13.name: Episode 39
13.overview: El Aziz hands down a harsh sentence to Leyla and Nanny. Ertugrul and Gundogdu return home to a slew of shocking news.

14.name: Episode 40
14.overview: News about Halime sends Ertugrul back on the road. Claudius accepts a mission that puts Ibn Arabi in harm's way.

15.name: Episode 41
15.overview: Kurdoglu tries to turn Suleyman and Gundogdu against Ertugrul, who negotiates with El Aziz at knife-point.

16.name: Episode 42
16.overview: Ustadi Azam loses his grip on Aleppo. At the camp, public opinion is not in Suleyman's favor, and Hayme cracks down on Selcan.

17.name: Episode 43
17.overview: Claudiu's mission hits a snag. Hayme discovers that Selcan has a personal vendetta, but Gundogdu stands by Selcan.

18.name: Episode 44
18.overview: Gundogdu unwittingly becomes a part of Kurdoglu's scheme. Hayme gives Halime and Gokce a dilemma.

19.name: Episode 45
19.overview: Gundogdu squares off with Ertugrul. Selcan stirs the pot at the family meal, where an unexpected guest arrives with distressing news for Halime.

20.name: Episode 46
20.overview: Cardinal Thomas and Titus carry out their plan with Turgut, whose decisions spell disaster for Ertugrul.

21.name: Episode 47
21.overview: Suleyman meets with the Seijuks, but Ertugrul's return throws the camp into disarray. Halime refuses the Seijuk sultan's offer.

22.name: Episode 48
22.overview: With their greatest obstacle out of the way, Ustadi Azam and Kurdoglu advance on their target, but Gundogdu tests Kurdoglu loyalty.

23.name: Episode 49
23.overview: A visitor brings news of Turgut to the Kayi camp and puts Kurdoglu in an unfavorable position. A murder plot unravels.

24.name: Episode 50
24.overview: Kurdoglu incurs Selcan's wrath. Izadora helps Suleyman connect the dots, and Eftelya gets her hands on an important letter.

25.name: Episode 51
25.overview: Ertugrul and Suleyman put Kurdoglu on the stand, but Gundogdu steps in. Thomas tests Ustadi Azam's patience.

26.name: Episode 52
26.overview: Turgut is not out of the woods yet. Selcan pulls strings to influence Gundogdu, and Hayme loses control of the situation.

27.name: Episode 53
27.overview: Gokce overhears Selcan's secret plan, and Suleyman invites a contest for power that threatens to pit his sons against each other.

28.name: Episode 54
28.overview: Gokce sees Selcan's true colors and confronts her. Gundogdu plays into Kurdoglu's hands, but someone more powerful has a hidden plan.

29.name: Episode 55
29.overview: Selcan loses favor with Gundogdu as her ambitions get the best of her. Kurdoglu unleashes another weapon to sow chaos in the camp.

30.name: Episode 56
30.overview: While Suleyman gives him the benefit of the doubt, Kurdoglu misleads Suleyman's men. Yigit life is in enemy hands.

31.name: Episode 57
31.overview: After losing their only witness, Ertugrul and his men are back to square one on the hunt for the traitor, but Izadora gives them another lead.

32.name: Episode 58
32.overview: Kurdoglu takes advantage of Ertugrul's absence. When the Knight's Templar outnumber Ertugrul, his wit is the only thing that can save him.

33.name: Episode 59
33.overview: Kurdoglu tries to force Selcan's hand and makes Turgut his right-hand man. Ertugrul has valuable information that Ustadi Azam needs.

34.name: Episode 60
34.overview: Struggling to keep order among his subjects, Kurdoglu hands down Suleyman's sentence and sets a dangerous trap for him and Hayme.

35.name: Episode 61
35.overview: Selcan repents and decides to mend fences with those she has betrayed. Ertugrul meets an unlikely ally.

1.name: Mall Hath No Fury
1.overview: A dangerous crime lord is terrorizing Moonbeam City, but handsome idiot detective Dazzle Novak is more concerned with getting his "#1 Cop" mug back from his rival, Rad Cunningham, than with cracking the case.

2.name: Lights! Camera! Reenaction!
2.overview: When Dazzle is approached by true-crime show "Crimezappers" about reenacting one of his arrests, he insists on directing the episode, but the hyper-expensive shoot quickly spirals out of control.

3.name: The Strike Visualizer Strikes Again
3.overview: Chrysalis leads a task force to catch a mysterious serial killer, and Dazzle is torn when his favorite artist becomes the prime suspect.

4.name: Quest for Aquatica
4.overview: Dazzle goes undercover at sea when he's inspired by Chrysalis' naval commander father, but the assignment is complicated by his affection for a dolphin named Splasha.

5.name: Glitzotrene: One Town's Seduction
5.overview: To prevent Mayor Eo Jaxxon from dismantling Moonbeam City's police department, the police hook the entire city on the synthetic drug "Glitzotrene", creating a drug epidemic. Guest starring Powers Boothe and Trace Adkins.

6.name: Lasers and Liars
6.overview: The team meets Pizzaz's family, Dazzle dates Pizzaz's estranged sister, Panache, while Rad tries to join a yacht club

7.name: Cop Con
7.overview: During the "Cop Con" police event, Dazzle and Pizzaz enjoy their annual romantic tryst. With Moonbeam City PD absent, the criminal element literally cleans up the town.

8.name: Stuntstravaganza
8.overview: Dazzle and his stuntman father, Razzle, reconnect; Rad loses his parking ticket and gets trapped in the PD garage by the security system.

9.name: The Legend Of Circuit Lake
9.overview: After Rad gets lost in the virtual world of the Moonbeam PD's records room, Dazzle is imprisoned for his murder, where he forms an erotic connection with the prison's artificially intelligent security system.

10.name: The Wedding Of Rad (Lie)
10.overview: Dazzle begins dating a mob boss's socialite daughter, and Rad is pressured by his Canadian grifter parents into getting sham-married to his own sister.

86942_s2.name: Season 2
86942_s2.overview: After the events of season one, Kim starts working at Human Rights. With help from former colleague Bob, her investigation into illegal Syrian weapons trade leads her to the El Dorado Ranch, a western horse ranch. Bob goes undercover to earn the trust of the brothers Berger, ranch owners & arms dealers. Meanwhile, Ferry Bouman continues his search for undercover agents Kim & Bob from jail…

1.name: El Dorado
1.overview: Bob Lemmens tracks down some arms dealers.

2.name: Pentagon
2.overview: The Berger brothers quickly reveal their true nature.

3.name: Soldiers of Love
3.overview: As Bob stews over a setback in the case, his daughter brushes up against his past, and the Bergers attempt to salvage a lucrative business deal.

4.name: Trojan Horse Power
4.overview: The lure of a fresh start leaves Nathalie feeling conflicted and vulnerable, while Bob pushes for a breakthrough in the case before his time runs out.

5.name: Revolucion
5.overview: Bob tries to make a deal with Laurent and JP Berger.

6.name: Victor
6.overview: Bob's attempt to use JP's past against him becomes a game of cat and mouse, Laurent's doubts about Nathalie boil over and Ferry issues an ultimatum.

7.name: Enrichochet
7.overview: When Nathalie's run-in with Laurent leaves Bob's case hanging by a thread, he bends the rules to the breaking point to motivate JP to make a deal.

8.name: Roadblock
8.overview: Pushed to the brink by everything he's done in pursuit of Ferry and the Bergers, Bob races to contain and cover up his various deceptions.

9.name: Reconstructie
9.overview: With Ferry's court date fast approaching, Bob faces the truth and considers the consequences of his actions. Laurent tries to tell JP what he knows.

10.name: Oorlog
10.overview: As the case comes down to the wire, Bob scrambles to protect Nathalie while JP takes steps to exact retribution on Laurent's behalf.

82455_s2.name: Season 2
82455_s2.overview: This season follows Team Ingebrigtsen through the 2017 and 2018 seasons.

1.name: Episode 1
1.overview: Henrik becomes a father, but also requires a hamstring surgery. Jakob keeps on setting new age world records and finds love.

2.name: Episode 2
2.overview: Little sister Ingrid decides she also wants to fully focus on running. Jakob attends the Junior European Championships in Italy and is a big favourite on three different distances, despite being only 16 years old.

3.name: Episode 3
3.overview: Jakob and Filip participate in the 2017 World Championship in London.

4.name: Episode 4
4.overview: Team Ingebrigtsen ends the 2017 season with the Norwegian Championship in their own city, where Jakob wins it easily as Henrik is still injured and Filip is ill.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: Team Ingebrigtsen has a very exciting summer ahead. Henrik is back after a year of injuries, Jacob is constantly breaking new records, and Filip is in the shape of his life. Little sister Ingrid takes part in her first international competition.

6.name: Episode 6
6.overview: Jakob participates in the Junior World Championships in Finland. Filip sets a new Norwegian record, with Jakob in second. Henrik hopes to fight back, as they all take part in the 2018 European Championships in Berlin.

60603_s1.name: Season 1
60603_s1.overview: In 1795, three teenage boys discovered a strange, man-made depression in the ground on Oak Island–a small, wooded island just off the coast of Nova Scotia, Canada. As the boys began to dig, they found a number of intriguing artifacts. It was the end of the piracy era and rumors of buried treasure were rampant. The boys’ discovery launched a treasure hunt that has spanned more than 200 years. The search had gone dormant, but last year, Rick and Marty Lagina, two brothers from Michigan with a life-long interest in the mystery, renewed the efforts to discover the legendary treasure.

1.name: What Lies Below
1.overview: Brothers Rick and Marty Lagina now own most of the mysterious Oak Island. Determined to resurrect the 200 year old search for treasure, they explore an abandoned shaft called 10-X. What they find gives them reason to believe that the stories of something buried on the island may very well be true.

2.name: The Mystery of Smith's Cove
2.overview: When the team discovers something very unusual at Smith's Cove, Rick and Marty Lagina believe they've made a huge breakthrough in unlocking Oak Island's secrets.

3.name: Outdoors: Voices from the Grave
3.overview: As Rick and Marty Lagina begin work to drain a mysterious swamp, they are visited by a woman who lost her father and brother to a tragic accident on Oak Island that gave rise to rumors of a deadly curse.

4.name: The Secret of Solomon's Temple
4.overview: A visitor to the island presents Rick and Marty Lagina with his incredible theory about where the treasure on Oak Island is located.

5.name: The Find
5.overview: Rick and Marty Lagina make one of the biggest discoveries in the 200-year old search for treasure on Oak Island.
